short_description: Turn meeting inputs into actionable minutes.
description: Create concise meeting minutes with decisions, owners, due dates, and follow-ups from notes, transcript pages, or published video captions.

requires: Authorized SandBase connection for capability calls

install.prompt: Use $meeting-minutes to turn this transcript into decisions and action items.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill meeting-minutes --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill meeting-minutes --agent codex --global

examples: Create minutes from these meeting notes.
Use this published meeting video to extract decisions and assigned actions.
notes: Call sandbase_describe_tool before each capability and pass only current schema-defined arguments.
Do not mutate external systems without explicit user authorization.

endpoints.summary: Read a selected page as clean Markdown.
Retrieve captions for a published YouTube video.
